versions.content: The ARTI template shall support a parameter for the current application Description: The ARTI template shall define a parameter that contains the evaluation for the current application that is running on a specific core. Rationale: ARTI needs to know which application is running at a core at a specific time. Dependencies: [RS_Arti_00001] Use Case: Debuggers and Tracing tools need to know the current application to display and trace the core activity. Supporting Material: -
